scope: Close every direct Java read of the NGE player-level datatables by proving that all five reads remain compatibility-only inside retired respec and live-conversion surfaces, while preserving the skill-investment PRE-CU difficulty adapter used by retained later content.

findings: Publish 14.1 player progression is driven by owned skill boxes and skill-specific XP, not player_level.iff combat-level thresholds.
The three old_player_level.iff reads are isolated in an uncalled legacy combat-level reconstruction helper.
The two player_level.iff reads are isolated in the retired NGE auto-level and live-conversion compatibility surfaces; retained expansion content uses a PRE-CU combat-skill investment adapter instead.

retiredRespecCompatibility.authority: Three reads reconstruct a legacy combat level in an uncalled helper; one supplies NGE template auto-level XP in a compatibility helper whose normal player, CTS, item, and live-conversion entrypoints fail closed.

retiredLiveConversionCompatibility.authority: The remaining read is in an uncalled roadmap free-skill helper on a script that detaches itself and is removed during player initialization and login.

buildEvidence.sourceAudit: passed; all five direct Java NGE player-level datatable reads are classified in retired compatibility surfaces with zero unclassified reads
buildEvidence.gameplayBuildReused: No gameplay source or data changed; the authenticated 5,717-source x64 deployment at the pinned dsrc/native revisions remains authoritative.
